_comment: Which agents /task-pipeline may use, in which role, for which deliverable kinds. tp.py enforces it. Agents not listed here are never used.

code-author.use: production code that makes the task's tests pass

test-author.use: tests written first and observed failing (red)

kb-author.use: knowledge-base articles and their index.md files

doc-author.use: READMEs, guides, references, runbooks, research write-ups

tutorial-author.use: hands-on tutorials whose commands are actually run

codebase-researcher.use: research: how named code is structured or how one named flow works; author: code research deliverables

domain-researcher.use: research: one bounded external-technology or standards question; author: external research deliverables

atlassian-liaison.use: research: requirements, criteria, and decisions in named Jira issues or Confluence pages; author: approved Jira/Confluence writes

github-liaison.use: research: named issues, PRs, review threads, or CI runs; author: approved GitHub writes

test-researcher.use: research: whether a named change needs new tests, where they go, and which cases, from the repo's own test patterns

impact-researcher.use: research: what depends on a named symbol, interface, config key, or CLI surface, and what a proposed change would break

doc-reviewer.use: accuracy and clarity of documents against their sources

code-reviewer.use: a broad sweep of a code change across every review lens (heavy: prefer the specific reviewers)

correctness-reviewer.use: logic, edge cases, error paths, concurrency, and resource cleanup in a code change

security-reviewer.use: untrusted input, authorization, secrets, data exposure, and crypto in a code change

api-compat-reviewer.use: breaking changes to APIs, CLI flags, config keys, and serialized formats

test-reviewer.use: whether new tests prove the acceptance criteria and would catch a regression

architecture-reviewer.use: structure of a code change with real architectural impact; never documents

ux-reviewer.use: a user-facing CLI/TUI/UI surface the change creates or alters

limits._review_minutes: seeded from live runs (a ~75-line doc: ~10 min; a small code diff: ~2-4 min); recalibrate from `tp report`
